tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, columns, chart plots, message bubbles from the agent.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A surface on a surface: a tool call inside a message, a popover.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code blocks, input fills, segmented-control tracks, progress tracks.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent fill for the composer, sticky bars and floating panels only. Pair with blur-glass.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, axis labels. 6:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, timestamps, captions. 4.5:1 or more on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: dividers, card rings, chart grid. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hairlines that separate dense rows: board columns, table rows.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of inputs, unchecked switches and checkboxes. 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, selected state, running agent state, links. One accent per view region.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for accent badges, the user message bubble, selected rows.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft and accent text on surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px. 3:1 or more on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done tasks, passed tool calls. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In review, needs input, slow steps. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked tasks, failed tool calls, destructive buttons. Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (blue). Assign in fixed order, never by rank.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (orange).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (aqua). Below 3:1 on light surface: ship direct labels.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (yellow). Below 3:1 on light surface: ship direct labels.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (magenta). Fold a 6th series into Other.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and the crosshair.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Guide-book cover title. One for each page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent opened 3 pull requests and waits for review.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI: task cards, table cells, descriptions.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, tool-call input and output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Task-card padding; gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Composer padding; message gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding inside large cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Guide-book chapter spacing.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, small chips, chart bar ends (4px in charts).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inputs inside dense rows, segmented-control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tool calls, task cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, board columns, message bubbles, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Composer, dialogs, large glass panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, switches, avatars, progress tracks.

shadow.note: Shadows draw edges, not elevation. Each starts with a 1px ring that replaces a border.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Default edge for cards, task cards, inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A layer above its neighbours: a dragged task, an open tool call, the switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Glass panels and the composer. One for each view.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented-control tracks, progress tracks, code blocks.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-edge
tokens.usage: Top specular highlight on glass and on primary buttons.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur for glass fills. Never above 24px.
